SELECT 
  id,
  \\"strategyId\\",
  symbol,
  decision::json->>'action' as action,
  decision::json->>'gridSummary' as grid_summary,
  decision::json->>'cost' as cost,
  decision::json->'gridSnapshot' as grid_snapshot,
  executed,
  \\"createdAt\\"
FROM \\"AiStrategyLog\\"
WHERE symbol IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY \\"createdAt\\" DESC
LIMIT 15;
" 2>&1)
